Maya: Quick win to share — hosted API just hit 1,000,000 requests in a single day 🎉🚀 p95 ~138ms, errors 0.05%. Huge props to runtime + infra. Free coffee tomorrow in the kitchen and a virtual happy hour at 4pm PT :tada: :coffee:
Sam: No way, amazing!!! All that batching and KV cache magic paid off. Who wants to bet when we hit 10M? :sunglasses:
Kevin: I'll bring donuts if we keep p95 < 150ms for a full week :donut: (vegan options included)
Olivia: Big shout to @Aisha and @Jun for the cache work — saw ~22% cost drop during the spike :raised_hands:
DeployBot: deploy-bot: Rollout v3.14 -> prod at 20:13 UTC; autoscale +3 nodes; health checks OK; no rollbacks detected
Maya: Also — CS already prepped a launch blurb, we'll push a short blog tomorrow. Huge thanks to docs and solutions folks :writing_hand:
Sam: Virtual happy hour link: https://meet.company/happyhour (4pm PT). I'll run a 10-min trivia with prizes :party_parrot:
Kevin: Donuts = confirmed. Adding a sprinkle-free option for the cautious eaters :yum:
Olivia: This was a team effort. Love seeing infra, runtime, cs, docs all clicking. Photo dump in the channel after happy hour? jk, but maybe.
Aisha: That cache rollout at 03:12 was tense but worked — worth it. So proud of y'all :heart:
